title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
description: A brothy, smoky chicken soup with tomatoes, black beans and corn, topped with crisp tortilla strips, avocado, lime and cilantro.

image.alt: A bowl of red tortilla soup topped with tortilla strips, avocado and lime

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 400F oven}. Toss the tortilla strips with 1 tbsp of the oil and a pinch of salt and bake until crisp and golden, {time 8-10 min}, stirring once.
Heat the rest of the oil in the pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and jalapeño until soft, {time 5 min}. Add the garlic, cumin and chili powder and stir for {time 1 min}.
Add the tomatoes, broth, whole chicken breasts and salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer gently until the chicken reaches {temp 165F internal}, {time 15-20 min}.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and return it to the pot with the beans and corn. Simmer for {time 5 min}.
Stir in the lime juice and taste for salt. Serve topped with tortilla strips, avocado and cilantro.

notes: Freeze the soup without toppings for up to 3 months. Crisp fresh tortilla strips when you serve it.
